mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals an overheating labor market that typically triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized expansion in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (2017=100) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and INDPRO does not produce a significant Rank IC (below 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the joint condition (HOUST>1300 AND INDPRO>100) fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5) signals an overheating economy that typically triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between CPIAUCSL and UNRATE does not produce a significant Rank IC (below 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the joint condition (CPIAUCSL>320 AND UNRATE<4.5) fails to produce negative returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (industrial production (INDPRO) below 100), the contraction in manufacturing output and economic activity leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.
